title: Sliding Window Maximum
description:
You are given an array of integers nums and an integer k. There is a sliding window of size k that moves from the very left of the array to the very right. You can only see the k numbers in the window. Each time the sliding window moves right by one position.

Return an array of the maximum value in each window, in order from the leftmost window to the rightmost window.

examples.explanation: A single element is its own window maximum.

approach: Maintain a monotonic deque of indices whose values are in decreasing order. Before recording a window's answer, evict indices that have slid out of the window from the front, and evict from the back any indices whose values are no larger than the current value (they can never be a maximum while the current element is in the window). The front of the deque is always the index of the current window's maximum. Each index is pushed and popped at most once, giving O(n) time and O(k) auxiliary space.
